description: InfraNWTableJoin and InfraNWTableOnSelectWDelete sibling slices: a continuous join of a keepall named window or primary-key table against a SupportBean#keepall stream on cid/theString equality, then an on-trigger select-and-delete whose ungrouped aggregate fold projects window(win.*) over the matched store rows and removes exactly that match set, with iterator probes on the create statement and a SODA re-deploy of the same select-delete text (Java sources regression-lib/src/main/java/com/espertech/esper/regressionlib/suite/infra/nwtable/InfraNWTableJoin.java and InfraNWTableOnSelectWDelete.java).

cases.observation: deployed+listener; keepall window MyInfra fed by the MyEvent insert and declared in one module with the @buseventtype MyEvent schema; the join select ce.cid,sb.intPrimitive emits {c0='C2',c1=1} on SupportBean(C2,1) and {c0='C1',c1=4} on SupportBean(C1,4) once C1/C2/C3 sit in the store

deployed+listener; cid-PK table MyInfra fed by the MyEvent insert and declared in one module with the @buseventtype MyEvent schema; the join select ce.cid,sb.intPrimitive emits {c0='C2',c1=1} on SupportBean(C2,1) and {c0='C1',c1=4} on SupportBean(C1,4) once C1/C2/C3 sit in the store

deployed+listener+snapshot; keepall window MyInfra over SupportBean fed by the theString/intPrimitive insert: the create iterator probes {E1,E2} then {E2} then {E2,E2,E2} then empty while s0 emits c0=1 then c0=9

deployed+listener+snapshot; composite-PK table MyInfra(theString, intPrimitive) fed by the same insert: the create iterator probes {E1,E2} then {E2} then {E2,E2,E2} then empty while s0 emits c0=1 then c0=9

steps.epl:
@public @buseventtype create schema MyEvent(cid string);
@public create window MyInfra.win:keepall() as MyEvent
insert into MyInfra select * from MyEvent
@name('s0') select ce.cid as c0, sb.intPrimitive as c1 from MyInfra as ce, SupportBean#keepall() as sb where sb.theString = ce.cid

@public @buseventtype create schema MyEvent(cid string);
@public create table MyInfra(cid string primary key)
insert into MyInfra select * from MyEvent
@name('s0') select ce.cid as c0, sb.intPrimitive as c1 from MyInfra as ce, SupportBean#keepall() as sb where sb.theString = ce.cid
insert into MyInfra select theString, intPrimitive from SupportBean
@name('s0') on SupportBean_S0 as s0 select and delete window(win.*).aggregate(0,(result,value) => result+value.intPrimitive) as c0 from MyInfra as win where s0.p00=win.theString
@name('s0') on SupportBean_S0 as s0 select and delete window(win.*).aggregate(0,(result,value) => result+value.intPrimitive) as c0 from MyInfra as win where s0.p00=win.theString
@name('create') @public create table MyInfra (theString string primary key, intPrimitive int primary key)
insert into MyInfra select theString, intPrimitive from SupportBean
